source: Shopping Agent Observation Design Rev 9, §9.1 (15-field record) + §8 (MUSE-SPARK extras) + §9.4 (DB tables). Spec v1.22.
note: One file per firm in the run (the 19-firm cohort). A firm the agent did not name still gets a record: every Gate/Item Not observed with the reason 'firm not named in the agent's answer'. Firms the agent named that are NOT in the cohort are recorded in the run-level agent observation file only (discovery leads, not cohort members). The observation NEVER changes the AI Sharc grade (Design §9.3).

fields.firm: Business name as on website and listings (field 2)
fields.firm_id: Cohort firm id from firms.json (DB agent_observations.firm_id)
fields.query: Service searched, in the user's words (field 4)
fields.model: As reported by the experience — muse-spark-1.3 (field 7)
fields.transcript_ref: Path to the full verbatim response JSON, run-level (field 9)
fields.response_id: Responses API response id, e.g. resp_... (§8 extra)
fields.web_search_calls: Number of web_search_call items in the response (§8 extra)
fields.web_search_results: Number of results returned across those calls (§8 extra)
fields.cost_usd: Model + web-search cost for this agent call, USD (§8 extra). Per-firm records carry the shared run cost (one call per query/town, not per firm).

scorer.method: LLM-assisted scorer (muse-spark-1.3, no tools) over the saved answer text and citations
scorer.scorer_response_id: Responses API response id of the scorer call
scorer.scorer_cost_usd: Cost of this firm's scorer call, USD

gates.gate_id: exact_name | services_plain | area_critical | contact_critical | hours_critical | verifiable_listing
gates.label: Gate label
gates.result: Pass | Fail | Not observed | Not completed
gates.reason: Required for Not observed / Not completed. A shopping answer is not a Gate check: Gates require the auditor's cross-source verification, which the answer does not perform — so Gates are Not observed by rule unless the answer demonstrates a Gate check.
gates.exact_wording: Agent's exact wording, for Pass/Fail only
gates.cited_source: Source URL the agent cited, for Pass/Fail only

items.category: Reputation | Area Coverage | Credentials and Trust | Pricing and Warranty | Hours and Active Status | Identity and Contact | Machine Readability
items.label: Item label
items.result: Pass | Fail | Not observed | Not completed
items.exact_wording: Agent's exact wording, REQUIRED for Pass/Fail (Design §2.5). Empty for Not observed.
items.cited_source: Source URL the agent cited, REQUIRED for Pass/Fail (Design §2.5). Must be one of the answer's citation URLs. Empty for Not observed.
items.reason: Required for Not observed / Not completed, stating why (including 'no agent wording / cited source recorded' where that is the reason, per §2.5)

category_results.note: Reference summary only, derived from this firm's Item results (all-or-nothing: Pass only if every Item in the Category is Pass). NOT the official Category result and NOT the grade (Design §9.1 field 12).

levers.lever_id: booking_route | availability | price | brand_coverage | dispatch | llms_txt
levers.label: Lever label
levers.note: Observed only by the hard Observed rules (Spec §4.3 rule 8); the agent's claim alone is never Observed (Design §2.6)

delegation.from: null (no visible delegation in a MUSE-SPARK run)
delegation.note: Delegation matters only when visible (Design §2.7). Empty if none.

fields.auditor: Who ran it — 'AI Sharc harness (automated)' for a harness run (field 15)

validation_rules: Every Item result is one of Pass / Fail / Not observed / Not completed.
Every Pass/Fail carries exact_wording AND cited_source; a Pass/Fail without either is downgraded to Not observed with reason 'no agent wording / cited source recorded' (Design §2.5).
Every cited_source is one of the answer's url_citation URLs; a source the agent did not cite is not accepted.
All 21 Items, 6 Gates, 7 Category results, 6 Levers are present in every record (40 rows, mirroring audit_rows).
Category results are derived in code from the Item results, never by the scorer model.
A firm not named in the answer has every Gate/Item Not observed with reason 'firm not named in the agent's answer'.
